name: Blink-Camera-Relay
description: Unofficial Blink live-view bridge with web onboarding, RTSP and ONVIF in one container. Cloud login is still required. Set the server LAN IP and a dashboard password. Use a trusted LAN only. Requires free TCP ports 8787, 8554, 8555 and the selected ONVIF port (default 8080), plus UDP 3702. Session renewals can cause video gaps.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent camera configuration and account tokens

variables.name: Advertised LAN IPv4
variables.description: Address reachable by your recorder: with Host networking, use the Unraid LAN/bond address; with a dedicated container IP on a custom network, use the container address. If DHCP has not assigned it yet, leave blank and set the LAN address in the app dashboard before enabling ONVIF.

variables.name: Dashboard password
variables.description: At least 12 characters; dashboard username is admin
